title: Comparison of independently normalized ordered affine integration
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a coefficient level n, a Noetherian scheme T on which l is invertible, and r with l^(r+1) annihilating the finite coefficient ring A, the independently defined orderedIntegration in any dimension d equals comparison of the ordinary affineTraceCounit constructed from projectiveLineTraceTransport and projectiveLineTraceDatum. This is an equality of actual morphisms in ordinary-comparison source coordinates, including d=0 and the empty base. Use [def-pur-proetale-ordered-integration] [def-amb-affine-trace-construction] [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates].

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3, restricted projective-line counit and induction along ordered coordinates. Site comparison of these named counits is agent-written, using Stacks proetale.tex Tags 099R and 09AF and categories.tex Tag 0B65.

proof.text: Prove naturality of towerSiteComparison on bounded-below objects by induction on the coordinate number. The successor factors are the line-site comparison, compatibility of the bounded-below compact-support functor with its ambient realization, the preceding tower comparison, and the compatibility map back. Naturality of each factor and induction give the equation.

Prefix comparison of the ordinary composite counit by towerSiteComparison. Its value in zero coordinates is the identity. For the successor, expand the composite-adjunction counit and the tower comparison, apply the preceding naturality equation to the ordinary line counit, cancel the intermediate bounded-below compatibility maps, and substitute lineCounit_comparison. The result is precisely TowerCounitRecursion.

The unique-family theorem identifies these compared ordinary counits with towerCounit. Specialize the bounded-below input to the constant object and cancel the inverse towerSiteComparison in orderedIntegration. This proves equality with comparison of affineTraceCounit. Zero coordinates and the empty base satisfy the same identity equations.

from.place: Every map involved was normalized by the Kummer generator; normalized vector-bundle integration at the normal-bundle endpoint. The affine-coordinate comparison is the independent part before vector-bundle gluing.

lean.statement:
theorem orderedIntegration_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (n : ℕ) (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r : ℕ)
    (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (d : ℕ) :
    orderedIntegration l E n T hT r hA d =
      (comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) T).map
        (Etale.affineTraceCounit _ (l ^ (r + 1)) hA
          (Etale.projectiveLineTraceTransport _ (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) _ hA)
          (Etale.projectiveLineTraceDatum _ (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) _ hA)
          T (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hT.pow (r + 1)) d)
